$comment: Brand data for hyperai-tui. scripts/build-patch.mjs reads these values to produce the pnpm patch that rebrands the pinned upstream @deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui package. The startup splash shows only the HYPERAI HARNESS pixel wordmark in titleColor; no logo, mascot or image is rendered, and no image protocol is involved.

core.policy: The installer refuses DSH Core versions outside validated; there is no bypass flag.
